title: Ancestor Lifespan and Era Analysis
dataSources: Tree records (`genealogy:record`), DNA matches (`dna:match`), ancestor events (`ancestor:event`), archive documents (`archive:document`), tree nodes (`familytree:node`).
app: Genealogy and family-history research — tree platforms (Ancestry, FamilySearch), DNA match exports (23andMe, MyHeritage), and document / archive catalogues — streamed to Splunk HEC via GEDCOM and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ancestor:event event=death
| eval lifespan=death_year-birth_year, era=floor(birth_year/50)*50
| stats avg(lifespan) as avg_lifespan, count as people by era
| sort era
description: Calculates ancestors' lifespans grouped by the era they were born in, revealing how longevity changed across generations.
value: Seeing lifespan rise across the centuries makes family history tangible and can hint at health patterns.
implementation: Ingest birth and death events into `index=personal`; average lifespan by era.
visualization: Column chart of average ancestor lifespan by 50-year era.
grandmaExplanation: It works out how long your ancestors lived in each era, showing how much longer people live now.
